author: Polar_Express
body: I would like to submit "Lands" to be considered as a walls map..Lands is a Walls map with 4 different quads and a unique mid section. please give it a look..Pics: http://imgur.com/a/oMZrw.Map DL with YML:  https://www.dropbox.com/s/qxr7wg60dfofdsl/lands.zip?dl=0.Special thanks goes to G_Skippy as the motivation for the map comes from the "Village" walls map. This map also shares the ore locations for Iron and Diamonds with that of the village, as that seems to work really well. I could not find G_Skippy, so I am adding him credit on the map. None of the village structures are used in this map, and almost every block above ground ( and most below) have been changed, but I did leave most of the ore locations the same..Info: .All quads have the same items and same amount of chests. The chest above ground on each quad share the same loot type with all the other quads. The below ground chests share the same loot as the other quads also. So no matter what quad you play the same items will be found above or below ground.The middle is custom and has an ice structure that houses the middle fire bow.. Ice may seem out of place, but as you play and discover the area under the middle it will all come together. I included screen shots for about half of the map.Thanks for looking - please contact me on Skype if you need more info. Polar_Express_Mc
